punchline: The teacher Adam Grant describes did not choose talent in advance; she looked for it in everyone.
thirty_sec: Adam Grant compares two kinds of teachers. One invests only in students who look bright to him. The other believes every student holds a potential that has not yet appeared, gives time to those who look ordinary and does not give up easily. Unexpected successes come out of children thought to be mediocre. These teachers create talent instead of filtering it out.
